title: Tightened valuation, ratio, and statement retrieval behavior
points: P/E numerator/denominator asks now preserve valuation-input attachments instead of rewriting curated view rows into empty model-ready tables.

Single-company dividend-yield answers now require one checked calculation from scaled dividends paid and current market cap, avoiding contradictory correction notes or DPS/share-count reconstruction when DPS was not retrieved.
Ratio questions with missing precomputed rows now return a clear unavailable-data answer instead of exposing internal lane failure text.
ROIC screen output now labels rankings as available-period averages inside the requested lookback, with usable-period disclosure, instead of implying full-horizon coverage.

Regression coverage now checks FFC/MARI P/E numerator-denominator answers, UPFL revenue evidence, low-debt positive-CFO screens, dividend-yield arithmetic, ratio unavailability, and ROIC coverage wording.

keystones.name: valuation_inputs attachments preserved for P/E answers
dividend yield uses scaled dividends paid over market cap
ROIC screen coverage labels available usable periods
